text: How does full-FORCE differ from standard (readout-only) FORCE?
choices: It trains only the output weights but with a larger aperture
It removes the feedback loop and trains the readout offline
It also trains internal recurrent weights (W_int), modifying W, at O(N^3) per step
It swaps RLS for an LMS gradient rule to reduce cost
explanation: Full-FORCE (DePasquale et al. 2018) trains a per-neuron set of internal weights in addition to the readout, using a target network, so the recurrent matrix becomes W + W_int (a rank-N correction) at O(N^3) per step versus FORCE's O(N^2). It keeps the feedback/RLS and does not use LMS or an aperture.
